summary: Planned residential highrise tower on the Potrero Power Station masterplan, up to 220 ft; the developer's 2026 Development Agreement amendment request would let the entire block become PDR/lab space (up to a 'small data center') instead, with no construction start found to date.

milestones.text: Developer proposes flexibility to build all-PDR space on Block 5, including describing a possible 'small data center' if a future tenant requires it, rather than the entitled residential building

Completion expected: Block 5 is not named in any Phase 1-3 block list found (the 2024 annual compliance report's Phase 1 list is Blocks 2, 7, 8, 11, 12, 15); only the whole-project buildout target applies
milestones.basis_note: Whole-project buildout target: the October 2020 Phase 1 and Phasing Plan Amendment revised construction from six phases to three over the same 16 years, with the final Phase 3 'wrapping up construction in late 2035' per SocketSite (Oct 9, 2020); Block 5 has no dated or phase-specific schedule of its own, and the 2026 all-PDR proposal above is not yet adopted.

facts.value: Residential, Institutional, Retail and Non-Retail Sales/Services uses permitted, plus limited PDR uses at the lowest floors (e.g. Light Manufacturing, Arts Activities, Business Services); Laboratory and Life Science uses Not Permitted under the adopted D4D final Table 3.1.1 -- the 2026 proposed DA amendment would add full-PDR flexibility (see milestones)

85 ft base with a 220 ft max upper tower, and a distinct 111 ft max callout on part of the block, per the D4D's Figure 6.2.3; the D4D's height-category text separately places Block 5 in a 'Highrise towers' category of 181-240 ft
One of three blocks (with 1 and 13) eligible to host the project's single permitted district parking garage (max 90 ft, with a publicly accessible rooftop sports field)
Not listed among the six Phase 1 blocks (2, 7, 8, 11, 12, 15) named in the 2024 annual compliance report

open_questions: No design review approval or construction-start date found for Block 5; it is not one of the six buildings named in the 2024 annual compliance report's Phase 1 list (Blocks 2, 7, 8, 11, 12, 15), and no later-phase design review approval was found either.

The Development Agreement amendment described in the Chronicle (July 2026) was pending Planning Commission/Board of Supervisors action as of this dossier's last-verified date; recorded here as a proposal, not an adopted change.
No phase-specific schedule found for Block 5; the added expected-completion milestone therefore uses only the whole-project buildout target (2035, SocketSite Oct 2020), not a block-specific date.
